description: Feed Component Architecture Refactoring - Simplify feed.svelte to pure presentation component

userStories.title: Create simplified Feed component with items prop
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Feed to accept items as a prop so that parents control their own data.
acceptanceCriteria: Feed accepts `getItemId` prop for unique identification
userStories.notes: Foundation story - Feed becomes pure presentation

userStories.title: Expose viewport state to parent
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to access start, end, down, and viewport from the parent so I can implement viewport-aware features.
acceptanceCriteria: Parent can read these values to trigger pagination, batching, etc.
userStories.notes: Required for US-003 and batchNewItems behavior

userStories.title: Add onNearBottom event for pagination
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Feed to emit an event when the user scrolls near the bottom so I can load more items.
acceptanceCriteria: Feed emits `onNearBottom` event when `end` is within 10 items of `items.length`
Event includes `{ distance: number }` indicating items remaining
Parent implements its own pagination logic (Nostr until/since, offset/limit, etc.)
Remove internal pagination logic (startPage, finalizePage, until/since calculation)
userStories.notes: Replaces ~110 lines of internal pagination logic

userStories.title: Add onRefresh event for pull-to-refresh
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Feed to emit an event on pull-to-refresh so parents can refresh their data.
acceptanceCriteria: When user pulls to refresh, call `onRefresh()` instead of internal `refreshHead()`
Parent implements refresh logic (new subscription, cache clear, etc.)
Show loading state during refresh if `loading` prop is true

userStories.title: Remove Fuse.js search from Feed
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to handle search/filtering in the parent so Feed is not coupled to search logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Parent filters `items` before passing to Feed
userStories.notes: Used in newchat, send, share modals

userStories.title: Remove connectionStatus binding
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to track connection status in the parent rather than binding it from Feed.
acceptanceCriteria: Parent tracks connection status via its own subscription handlers
No changes to how connection status is displayed (RelaysList in parent)
userStories.notes: Parent already has access to connection status

userStories.title: Migrate explore/index.svelte to new Feed API
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to migrate the main explore feed to use the new simplified Feed component.
acceptanceCriteria: Add subscription handling in parent (move from Feed)
Use `bind:start` to detect when user is at top (for batchNewItems behavior)
Verify in browser: scroll, pagination, refresh all work
userStories.notes: Most complex pagination - quantile-based window calculation

userStories.title: Migrate notifications/index.svelte to new Feed API
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to migrate the notifications page to use the new Feed component.
acceptanceCriteria: Move `updateFeed` logic (grouping by type) to parent
Process events into `items` array in parent
Verify in browser: notifications display correctly

userStories.title: Migrate chat/index.svelte to new Feed API
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to migrate the chat conversations list to use the new Feed component.
acceptanceCriteria: Move DM processing logic (group by chatId) to parent
Process events into `items` array in parent
Verify in browser: conversations list correctly

userStories.title: Migrate _kinds/kind4.svelte to new Feed API
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to migrate the DM conversation view to use the new Feed component.
acceptanceCriteria: Move nonce-based deduplication logic to parent
Handle optimistic UI (sent messages) in parent
Process events into `items` array in parent
Verify in browser: send/receive messages work
userStories.notes: Has optimistic UI for sent messages

userStories.title: Migrate home/+layout.svelte to new Feed API
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to migrate the home/wallet feed to use the new Feed component.
acceptanceCriteria: Sort items in parent before passing to Feed
Verify in browser: wallet feed displays correctly
userStories.notes: Wallet/Nuts feed - filters for kind9321 events

userStories.title: Migrate modals to new Feed API
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to migrate modal feeds (send, newchat, share, followlists) to use the new Feed component.
acceptanceCriteria: send.svelte: Move contact dedupe/sorting to parent
newchat.svelte: Move contact dedupe/sorting to parent
share.svelte: Move contact dedupe to parent, handle grid items
followlists.svelte: Move kind39089 filtering to parent
Verify in browser: all modals work correctly
userStories.notes: Already migrated as part of US-005 - all 4 modals use items prop and getItemId

userStories.title: Migrate _kinds/kind0.svelte and kind1.svelte to new Feed API
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to migrate profile and thread views to use the new Feed component.
acceptanceCriteria: kind0.svelte: Move feed request building to parent, pass `items`
kind1.svelte: Move reply filtering to parent, pass `items`
Verify in browser: profile posts and thread replies work
userStories.notes: Migrated to new Feed API - parent manages subscriptions and passes items prop

userStories.title: Clean up old Feed code
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove all obsolete code from Feed after migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove buffer Maps (cachedMap, fetchedMap, bufferMap, pendingNewItems)
Keep: VirtualList rendering, slots, sticky header/footer CSS, `start`/`end`/`down`/`viewport` binding
Final verification: all 12 Feed usages work correctly
userStories.notes: Feed component is already clean - contains only VirtualList rendering, slots, sticky CSS, and viewport bindings
